interpolation: Optional bracket-only linear crossing estimate; labelled INTERPOLATED_CROSSING_ESTIMATE, never an accepted frame or replacement for the strict gate
cpu_additional_state_rule: One maximum archived equation-residual step from each dt; duplicate endpoints removed
cpu_independent_reference: F10H separately implemented pair-force residual / Powell hybrid reference; require actual residual <=1e-14 m, retain solver success separately
cpu_tightening_policy: Only continue tightening a saved state when the previous solve converges; retain every failure, no stiffness/iteration sweep
gpu_admission_before_development: Independent edge reconstruction and group shape gates pass, local solver-error comparison complete, strict timing failure mechanism supported by actual distances/slopes; original strict FAIL remains
gpu_scope: Independent B=1 fixed-state candidate only: two/four before one saved32; no modified production default, no B64, no complete physics trajectory
gpu_cost: Five warm matched fixed-state repetitions; report CPU assembly/contact, allocation/preparation, GPU solve with host control, synchronization/readback, full step, graph construction and memory separately; no kernel-only speed claim
gpu_stop: Stop expansion if small or saved32 gates fail, unexplained active-set differences, bounded nonconvergence, clear end-to-end cost disadvantage or substantial engine refactor required
new_trajectory_policy: Default NOT_RUN. At most one justified short tighter-tolerance or 2.5us reference, after a written evidence-based decision; no unvalidated restart
persistent_topology_no_events: NO_PERSISTENT_SPLIT_OR_MERGE_OBSERVED; predictive event accuracy NOT_EVALUATED, do not call the empty test a general pass
